// PROBE — colour and emphasis driven by severity.
export function Chip({ gap }: { gap: { severity: string; title: string } }) {
    const emphasis = gap.severity === "critical" ? "font-bold" : "font-normal"
    return <span className={`pill ${gap.severity === "high" ? "bg-red-100" : ""} ${emphasis}`}>{gap.title}</span>
}
